
## Summary

**Rewrite verbose panel body copy** (residual after DUX5)

Long paragraphs combine status, scope, caveat and instructions.

## Priority / wave

- Priority: **P2**
- Wave: **V3**
- Complexity: **M**
- Audit code: `UX-P2-01`
- DUX code: `DUX6-20`

## Scope

Run Explorer, DQ handoffs, Incident impact, Trust latency/help.

Screenshot groups: SG-01,02,03,07

## Concrete change

Split into STATUS, REASON, IMPACT, ACTION, SCOPE, FRESHNESS; cap main body at 2–4 lines.

## Expected effect

Lower reading time and fewer missed actions.

## Acceptance criteria

- Every primary card passes a 5-second comprehension review; help text is outside the primary body.
- Live/screenshot evidence at 1366×768 (blocking) after change
- No new high-cardinality Prometheus labels
- No hidden verdict logic only in Grafana transforms

## Dependencies

UX copy review with SRE/domain owners.

## Risk

Shortening can remove necessary caveats; retain them in description/runbook.

## Predecessor / residual notes

#7128 DUX5-20 closed — residual: Run Explorer layers/artifacts still verbose

## Constraints

- Surgical dashboard JSON; preserve panel IDs where possible
- Prefer description/runbook for caveats; first-screen ≤2–4 lines
- Tech-debt budgets non-increasing

## Verification

- [ ] Before/after screenshots (dark)
- [ ] Viewports 1366/1440/1920 @100% (125% if layout-sensitive)
- [ ] Targeted pytest if JSON structure changes
- [ ] 5-second operator comprehension on first-screen card
